resources.string: Messages, missed calls, reminders, emails and bills show up here as soon as Earmark picks them up.

plurals.name: recap_open_loops
plurals.item: Watching %d open loop. It can come back as a chip when you unlock, or as a pill if you drift into a feed app. The Log shows each step.
Watching %d open loops. The likeliest can come back as a chip when you unlock, or as a pill if you drift into a feed app. The Log shows each step.

resources.string: Never blocked an app. Never counted a minute.
Earmark is paused. It won\'t show chips or pills until you resume.
Earmark is missing a permission, so it can\'t guess yet.
Your phone may pause Earmark while you\'re in other apps, so chips and pills would only show when you open it. Let it run in the background.
Notification access is on, but Android hasn\'t connected Earmark yet, so it can\'t see new messages. Turn Earmark\'s notification access off and on again.
These post real notifications that Earmark reads like any other app\'s. After sending one, lock the phone, unlock it, then open a feed app such as YouTube. The pill comes right away.
Bedtime: demo mode gives you a habit of a 6:30 alarm on weeknights. While no alarm is set for tomorrow, the next unlock offers to set one.
Running in the background so it can guess when you unlock.
No chips and no pills until you turn this off.
Sample notifications, and the pill comes right away, so every story runs on any phone.

How long a feed app can be in front before Earmark offers to hand the loop back. Right away offers it a few seconds after you open the feed. Smart goes by how long you usually stay in each feed app, and comes back sooner for something urgent or a chip you said yes to.
Time in these apps counts toward drift. Nothing is ever blocked.
A group message that says one of these names counts as for you, like an @mention. Earmark also reads your own contact card if you allow Contacts. Kept on this phone and never logged.
You ignored these three times in a row, so Earmark stopped guessing them.
Why each chip or pill was or wasn\'t shown. No message text is ever written here.
Nothing yet. Lock and unlock the phone to see a decision.
Your phone remembers what you picked it up for.
Earmark reads what\'s waiting for you, on this phone only. It never blocks an app and never counts minutes. It needs three permissions to work.
To see messages, missed calls, reminders, emails and bills, and open the exact one.
To know which app is in front, only while the screen is on.
To show the chip and the pill on top of any app.
For Leave-by loops: when to set off for an event or join a call.
Reads only your own contact card, so Earmark can tell when a group message says your name. Your other contacts are never read. You can also type your names in Settings.
So the phone doesn\'t pause Earmark while you\'re in other apps. Samsung phones need this.
Shows that Earmark is running, and lets demo mode post sample messages.
Android 13 and later restrict this setting for apps installed from a file. Open App info, tap the three-dot menu, choose Allow restricted settings, confirm, then come back and try again.
No account, no servers, and no internet permission. Message text stays in memory until the loop closes.
